name: E2E-SEED-010 — 种草图文与视频链路隔离验证
description: 验证种草图文(seedGenerate/pipelineSeed)与种草视频(seedVideoGenerate/pipelineSeedVideo)两条链路完全独立：各自去重、各自容量管控、各自processMode、互不影响。同一商品可同时触发两条链路。
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草链路

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'pipeline-isolation', scenario: '图文/视频链路隔离', imagePipeline: { processMode: 'seedGenerate', pipelineIdSource: 'MaterialRouteDiamondConfig.pipelineSeed()', pipelineId: '20241(预发)', capacityApi: 'countFirstApproveUnfinished(pipelineSeed)', dedupWindow: '72h(SEED_DEDUP_LOOKBACK_MINUTES=4320)', maxPending: 2000 }, videoPipeline: { processMode: 'seedVideoGenerate', pipelineIdSource: 'MaterialRouteDiamondConfig.pipelineSeedVideo()', pipelineId: '20227(默认)/20248(预发)', capacityApi: 'countFirstApproveUnfinished(pipelineSeedVideo)', dedupWindow: '72h(SEED_VIDEO_DEDUP_LOOKBACK_MINUTES)', totalSwitch: '视频总开关(默认OFF)' }, isolationPoints: ['各自processMode独立', '各自pipelineId独立', '各自去重窗口独立', '各自容量管控独立', 'F层级查询共享(一次查询)', '类目过滤共享(isClothingItemForSeed一次判定)'] }; })()

steps.description: 验证隔离规则定义正确

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境MQ可用；视频总开关已打开；存在F0测试商品
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.F0商品触发双链路 2.验证两条PENDING记录分别落库 3.验证processMode/pipelineId各自独立 4.验证去重/容量各自独立 5.验证F层级查询和类目过滤共享
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①同一商品产生两条独立PENDING记录 ②processMode分别为seedGenerate和seedVideoGenerate ③两条链路各自按容量/去重提交 ④F层级查询和类目过滤共享一次结果
_testDesign.dbAssertion: 同item_id存在两条记录: processMode IN ('seedGenerate','seedVideoGenerate'), 各自独立流转
riskPoints: 两条链路共享F层级查询,查询失败时双链路都不触发
视频总开关默认OFF,需确认已打开
